extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and the extensions page.

extDescription.message: Practise English pronunciation on any web page: select text, listen to it, shadow it, and review what you practised.
extDescription.description: Extension description. Keep in sync with the single-purpose statement.

commandOpenPanel.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut shown in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

errRestrictedPage.message: This page can't be used. Try a normal website.
errRestrictedPage.description: Shown when the shortcut is pressed on chrome://, the Web Store or the PDF viewer.

errNothingSelected.message: No text selected. Highlight some text and try again.

errOpenPanelFailed.message: The panel could not open automatically. Open it from the toolbar icon.

errTtsUnavailable.message: Speech is not available in this browser. You can still read the IPA.

errMicDenied.message: Microphone blocked. Click here to allow it.

errMicUnavailable.message: No microphone was found. Check that one is connected and try again.

errRecordingFailed.message: Recording could not start. Try again.

errRecognitionUnsupported.message: Word checking is not available in this browser. You can still compare your take by ear.

errUnknown.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errQuota.message: There is no space left to save this. Delete a saved item and try again.

errImportInvalid.message: That file is not a valid saved-items export.

errImportEmpty.message: That file contains no saved items.

errImportTooMany.message: That file contains too many items to import.

microButtonLabel.description: Accessible name of the 28 px button that appears next to a selection.

microButtonFirstRun.description: Tooltip shown once on the very first selection, per spec 4.1.

popupNotFound.message: No definition found for this word. The pronunciation may still be available.

popupOffline.message: The dictionary is not reachable. Check your connection and try again.

popupRateLimited.message: The dictionary is busy right now. Try again in a moment.

popupServerError.message: The dictionary returned an error. Try again in a moment.

popupNoDefinitions.message: No definitions are available for this word.

popupTranslate.description: Small link that opens Google Translate in a new tab with the selected text.

popupIpaNote.message: IPA with the stressed syllable highlighted.

popupApproximateIpa.description: Shown when a word is not in the bundled dictionary and a rough letter-to-sound spelling is used.

popupUsFallback.message: US pronunciation shown; no UK transcription is available.
popupUsFallback.description: Spec 5.2: never invent UK IPA we did not source.

popupPanelFallback.message: The panel could not open automatically. Open it from the toolbar icon.

popupSentenceMeaningUnavailable.message: Meanings are available for single words only.

popupFirstSentence.message: Only the first sentence will be practised.
popupFirstSentence.description: Shown when a selection was longer than 300 characters.

practiceTextPlaceholder.message: Select text on a page, or paste a sentence here.

micExplanation.message: Your browser will ask for microphone access the first time you record. The audio stays on this device.

micPrivacyNote.message: Chrome's speech recognition may send your audio to Google to check which words it heard. You can turn this off in Settings.

recordingTooShort.message: That take was too short. Record again and say the whole phrase.

autoStopNote.message: Recording stops automatically after a short silence, or at 30 seconds.

checkWordsUnsupported.message: Word checking is not available in this browser. You can still compare your take by ear.

resultNote.message: This checks which words were recognised, not individual sounds or your pronunciation score.

noTakeYet.message: Record a take to see which words were recognised.

noTextToPractise.message: Select text on a page, or type something above to start.

autoSaveNote.message: Saved automatically after your first recording. You can turn this off in Settings.

sourcePageNote.message: When enabled, new saved items also store the page title and address.

savedEmpty.message: No saved items yet. Select a word or sentence and choose Save.

savedClearConfirm.message: Delete every saved item? This cannot be undone.

savedImportInvalid.message: That file is not a valid saved-items export.

savedImportEmpty.message: That file contains no saved items.

savedImportTooMany.message: That file contains too many items to import.

savedMeaningUnavailable.message: Meanings are available for single words only.

voiceOsNote.message: Available voices depend on your operating system and browser.

openPracticeAutomatically.description: Skip the quick-read pop-up and open the side panel when the micro-button is clicked.

autoSaveAfterFirstRecording.message: Save automatically after my first recording

storeSourcePage.message: Store the source page with saved items

privacyBody.message: Your selections, saved items and recordings stay on this device. Only the selected word is sent to the free dictionary API to look up its meaning. Chrome's speech recognition may send your audio to Google when word checking is on. YouGlish opens as a normal website when you ask for native examples.

creditsBody.message: Dictionary data from Wiktionary via freedictionaryapi.com (CC BY-SA 4.0). Pronunciations from CMUdict (BSD-style licence). Native examples by YouGlish.com.

clearCacheConfirm.message: Clear cached definitions? Saved items are not affected.

onboardTitle1.message: Select any text on a page.

onboardBody1.message: A small button appears next to your selection. Click it, or press Alt+Shift+S.

onboardBody2.message: Hear the phrase in US or UK English, then repeat it in the gap.

onboardBody3.message: See which words were recognised, save what you practised, and come back to it later.

permissionBody.message: English Shadowing needs microphone access to record your voice. Audio stays on this device unless word checking sends it to Chrome's speech service.

permissionGranted.message: Microphone allowed. You can close this tab and return to the panel.

permissionDenied.message: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the browser's site settings, then try again.

permissionHint.message: Tip: after allowing access here, press Record again in the panel.

noticeRestricted.message: This page can't be used. Try a normal website.

noticeNoSelection.message: No text selected. Highlight some text and press Alt+Shift+S again.
